refinement.glass: macOS 26+ uses NSGlassEffectView.regular with transparent WKWebView content, clipped 18px corners and no WebKit focus ring. Browser/Windows/older macOS or SDK retain CSS title-glass fallback.
refinement.lowViewport: 390x400: card top 8, bottom 312, max-height 304 after live resize; ResizeObserver updates placement.
refinement.reset: No reset icon or provider header. Default is the first slider stop and saves empty effort; remaining stops are only supported levels.
refinement.appearance: 28px system-blue selected range, neutral gray remainder, fixed supported-level dots and a white 28px thumb. 240ms eased movement, direct pointer tracking; reduced motion removes transition.
refinement.sourceSwitch: One current-provider icon/name row and a right arrow; click advances provider, Left/Right keys move backward/forward. Browsing never submits model selection; only chosen providerId/modelId is saved. Reopen resets to actual selected model provider.
refinement.default: Default remains slider stop 0 with empty effort; no refresh/reset icon.

stableSaving.writes: max then high; intermediate choices coalesced, one continuous busy=true/false batch, focus stays on range, no list reload or resize during save.
